goal.intent: Make agent-runtime main governance fail closed on PR-only changes and exact CI/CodeQL checks while preserving zero-approval agent workflows and auto-merge

acceptance.acceptance: One versioned source of truth defines desired repository governance and exact check identities
Validator rejects absent renamed ambiguous wrong-app or disabled governance and workflow trigger gaps
Zero human approvals, no thread/environment gates or merge queue, and auto-merge remains usable
Repository main ruleset matches the merged contract with proven readback and rollback evidence
Issue #4 closes only on clean synchronized terminal main with post-main evidence

non_goals: Modify organization rulesets, credentials, secrets, environments, apps, teams or other repositories
Change observability, Task, Goal or runtime product semantics
Create a merge queue, human approval gate, release, tag or version
